page.layout: One column of text on the left, with marginal notes in the right margin. Running head centred at the top, page number at the top right, catchword at the bottom right. Heading "SECTIO V. DE COSTIS." stands between the paragraphs.

main_text.p: Costa.[?]Os sacrum ad latera, ante & retro, est perforatum: estque anteriore parte leve & sinuum, posteriore gibbum.
Ossis hujus cùm sunt processus, tùm etiam sinus in extimis trium ossium superiorum lateribus, quorum medius major & profundior.
Os coccygis est ultima dorsi portio ex quatuorOs coccy-gis. ossiculis constructa, ab ossis sacri extremitate velut cauda pendens.
Primum ossiculum coccygis reliquis est latius & majus, superne sinum habens,Costa.[?] quo imam postremi sacri ossis partem excipit.
Reliqua tria rotunda quodammodo sunt, & in acutum tendunt.
PutaturCosta.[?] os coccygis à sacro laxari & versus posteriora flecti, cum mulieres foetum emittunt.
main_text.head: SECTIO V. DE COSTIS.
main_text.p: Quinta SectioHæc de ossibus pectoris & dorsi, interSexta Sectio[?] quæ interseruntur utrinque lateralia ossa, quæ dicuntur COSTÆ.

page.notes: Marginal notes are faint and partly illegible: the top right note (beside the first paragraph) reads as "Costa." and is uncertain; the notes beside the "Primum" and "Putatur" paragraphs read as "Costa" and are uncertain; the lowest right note reads as "Sexta Sectio" and is uncertain. The "Quinta Sectio" note is clear. Faint mirrored text (show-through from the other side of the leaf) and the faint mark at lower left are not transcribed. The first paragraph is treated as continuing from the previous page.
